method: 36 deterministic bot matches (two maps, two symmetric opening states, both sides for unequal levels); fixed-board logistics and siege comparisons; exact-army marshal duels. No network, leaderboard or human win-rate claims.
limitations: Deterministic cases are correlated, not independent statistical samples
Opening states are symmetric and intentionally limited
Siege defender repairs but never counter-attacks; starting siege armies are supplied as fixtures, not purchased
No human playtesting or population win rates
Marshal duel isolates a one-turn exchange; no free healing or extra resources were added
